summary_md: **Twoshots 🌙 ([@Twoshotsai](https://x.com/Twoshotsai/status/2116426557594149218))** presents **archwhere**, which maps each PR to the architecture component it touches and flags security zones, arguing that agents editing sensitive code unflagged is a blind spot ([tapaskar/archwhere](https://github.com/tapaskar/archwhere)).
